data.body:
[P2] Release outstanding invoke guards when their caller finishes

`unregister()` removes the participant but leaves its outstanding entries in `invokes`. If a workflow races a one-second wait against a registered non-durable function that never resolves, the wait can finish the workflow, but `handleInvokeUpdate()` never reaches `invoke.end()`. Every subsequent runner sharing this fake clock then hits the invoke guard in `advance()`, so an unrelated one-hour wait takes a real hour despite `skipTime`. Track the caller owning each handoff and release its guards when that execution settles. Add a regression that completes this race and then runs an unrelated long wait under the same test environment.
